messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Summary.fitted.values order of results
parts:
The numbering is IDX, GROUP, then REPLICATE

so with NGROUPS=2, and NREPLICATE=1, then its

1:N (for group=1)
1:N (for group=2)

you may use

?inla.idx

to map indices, in case you want something general.
